verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents WebSDK permalinks that let applicants complete verification through a direct link, which is the core of sending a verification by link. The evidence does not show that ops staff can generate these links from the dashboard without engineering work, and it never mentions QR codes. Missing for 10: explicit no-code or dashboard generation of permalinks by non-engineers, QR code delivery, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can send a verification to someone with a no-code link or QR code — no engineering ticket to verify a one-off customer, contractor, or seller

citations.quote: WebSDK permalinks help applicants pass verification via a direct link to the WebSDK.
